name: Eternity
bio: Archetype: AoE DPT, ST DPT, Self-Sustain. ⌽ [Blood of Longevity], [Blood of Immortality] and Ultimate healing makes her extremely hard to kill. ⌽ Immune to several annoying statuses like [Poison], [Corrode], [Bleed], and all [Stats Down] at Insight 3. ⌽ Can (slowly) solo most early- to mid-game content. ⌽ Harsh drop-off in late-game.
